deliberation: The ten-times cadence justifies reducing elapsed committee time when scope is reduced proportionately. One historical or isolated task class, one repository, no live authority, and a protected verification reserve preserve responsible stewardship while targeting the bottleneck promptly.
discharged_obligations: Balanced urgency, operator burden, ownership, and safety.
findings: The accelerated programme has bounded cost and a clear failure route.
Council Steward advice is not Human Steward ratification.
amendments: Require named owners, kill switch, incident route, cost ceiling, expiry, and decommission plan in the terminal packet.
residual_uncertainty: The economic threshold may lack adequate samples.
